visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with stock-style footage of two men wearing white hard hats and grey/navy work clothes, straining to lift a large cardboard box in a warehouse-like environment with wooden scaffolding. (2) Transition to a man in a white T-shirt and a dark baseball cap in a brightly lit bathroom; he is holding a baby wrapped in a white hooded towel and speaking directly to the camera. (3) The man demonstrates a white X-shaped metal stand, opening it with both hands to show how it supports a baby bathtub; the background includes a glass shower stall and tiled walls. (4) Various shots show the baby sitting comfortably in a greyish 'moon-shaped' bathtub (Shnuggle brand) filled with water; the man bathes the baby, showing the ergonomic support. (5) The man demonstrates a grey diaper changing mat placed on the same stand; he places the baby on it, highlighting its tilted design. (6) The video ends with the man holding the baby in his arms, smiling and speaking the final remarks toward the camera in the bathroom setting.

It uses a helpful, expert-dad persona to build trust and demonstrate ease of use.
